about_short_description.short_description: Pursuit removes friction from public sector contracting.

product.name: Pursuit Radar
product.description: An AI-powered public-sector opportunity intelligence product that monitors agency documents and transcripts for buying signals, relevant projects, budgets, and competitor mentions before an RFP is issued.

product.name: Pursuit Intel
product.description: A continuously refreshed database of public-sector entities and contacts that provides organizational, budget, technology, purchasing, and propensity-to-buy data and synchronizes it with CRM systems.

product.name: Pursuit Chrome Extension
product.description: A browser extension that identifies public-sector entities and contacts on webpages, shows their presence in the CRM, and exports missing buying-committee contacts directly into the CRM.
